intro: A signed record of your regular income and payment history. Choose what to include and the period.
title: Credit record
verifyExplainer: Checks the signature and fingerprint. A valid result means the record has not changed since it was issued.
shareMessage: My Kassa credit record. Check it here:
linkCopied: Link copied. Paste it anywhere to share.
shareFailed: Could not share. Copy the link from the verification page instead.
paymentsOnTime: Bill payments sent by the due date
nameFooterKyc: The record binds the holder's identity-checked full name. Only match or no match is shown; the name itself is never revealed.
nameFooterProfile: The record binds the full name on the holder's account (not identity-checked). Only match or no match is shown.
importedHistory: Includes the account's simulated history before Kassa, imported when the demo account was set up (opened {{date}}).
